title:
Transforms `MapReduce#run.status` `status` and `completed` fields to displayable values in the UI.
The status field, is mapped into a valid option using by `Reliability.RunJobStatusCustomCell` component.
completed field date, is formatted as a string with the format `MM/DD/YYYY`.
- For {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}, the fields are sourced from the path `workflowRun.runStatus`.
- For others, the fields are sourced from the path `run.status`.
name: ModelSetupJobsRunStatusCellTranslateTransform
